reason: Calendar notifications serve a directly functional purpose: they alert the user to upcoming events and deadlines in advance. Unlike promotional or social notifications, which introduce noise without commensurate benefit, Calendar alerts carry high signal-to-noise ratio — each notification corresponds to a specific, user-created obligation. For someone who relies on structured scheduling and values punctuality, disabling these would represent a meaningful operational liability. The Default Alert Times setting visible in the app settings confirms the system is configured to deliver such reminders. I would keep them on.
